dialogues.jp: 「遅いな……」
dialogues.en: "She's late..."
dialogues.text: "She's late..."

dialogues.jp:
パンをお手玉のように｛もてあそ／弄｝ぶ。貴重な昼休みの、
２０分が無為に失われてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I idly played with the bread packet I was holding. 20
minutes of our precious lunch break had already passed.
dialogues.text:
I idly played with the bread packet I was holding. 20
minutes of our precious lunch break had already passed.

dialogues.jp: 「何やってんだろ、ことり……」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing, Kotori..."
dialogues.text: "What are you doing, Kotori..."

dialogues.jp:
昼休みはいつも、中庭のこの指定席で、ことり
と一緒に昼飯を食べる。さすがに教室でカップ
ルするほど、二人とも露出好きではなかった。
dialogues.en:
Every lunch break, we would go to this seat in the
courtyard, practically reserved for us, and eat lunch
together.
dialogues.text:
Every lunch break, we would go to this seat in the
courtyard, practically reserved for us, and eat lunch
together.

dialogues.jp:
このベンチに来るのは、いわば不文律みたいな
もので、お互い特に何も言う必要がない。
dialogues.en:
That we'd both come to this bench was almost an unwritten
law. We never needed to say anything to each other about it.
dialogues.text:
That we'd both come to this bench was almost an unwritten
law. We never needed to say anything to each other about it.

dialogues.jp:
俺が先に来ることもあるし、ことりが待ってい
ることもある。その辺は緩やかだ。けど……。
dialogues.en:
I arrived first, so I decided to wait for Kotori. Of course
I would try to be lenient. But this...
dialogues.text:
I arrived first, so I decided to wait for Kotori. Of course
I would try to be lenient. But this...

dialogues.jp: 「こんな遅れたこと、なかったよな……」
dialogues.en: "She's never been this late before..."
dialogues.text: "She's never been this late before..."

dialogues.jp:
せっかく買ったホットの紅茶も、ぬるくなって
しまっている。
dialogues.en: The hot black tea I had bought had grown cold.
dialogues.text: The hot black tea I had bought had grown cold.

dialogues.en: "...Maybe she's at the nurse's office?"
dialogues.text: "...Maybe she's at the nurse's office?"

dialogues.jp:
授業中もずっと調子が悪そうだった。もしかし
て、休んでいるのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
She didn't look good during the lessons. Maybe she went
there to rest...
dialogues.text:
She didn't look good during the lessons. Maybe she went
there to rest...

dialogues.jp:
見に行こうかとベンチを立ったとき、校舎から
ことりが向かってくる姿が見えた。
dialogues.en:
I stood up ready to check there, when I saw Kotori's figure
emerge from the school building.
dialogues.text:
I stood up ready to check there, when I saw Kotori's figure
emerge from the school building.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい。遅くなって……」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I'm late..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I'm late..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうかしたの？」
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……別に、なんでもないんです」
dialogues.en: "...Nothing, nothing happened."
dialogues.text: "...Nothing, nothing happened."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……そう。あら？　弁当は？」
dialogues.en: "...Is that...so? Where's your lunchbox?"
dialogues.text: "...Is that...so? Where's your lunchbox?"

dialogues.jp:
何故かことりは手ぶらだった。いつもは、布に
包まれた可愛い弁当箱を持っているはずなのに。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's hands were unusually empty. She'd normally be
carrying a cute little lunchbox wrapped up in a
handkerchief.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's hands were unusually empty. She'd normally be
carrying a cute little lunchbox wrapped up in a
handkerchief.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん……ちょっと……食欲がなかったんです。
　それで、今日は……」
dialogues.en: "I... didn't bring it... I didn't feel hungry today.. so..."
dialogues.text: "I... didn't bring it... I didn't feel hungry today.. so..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そっか……あ、ジュースは？」
dialogues.en: "I see... how about some juice, at least?"
dialogues.text: "I see... how about some juice, at least?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりはぺこりと頭を下げて受け取ると、両手
で缶を包み込むようにした。
dialogues.en: Kotori nodded, and took one of the cans with both hands.
dialogues.text: Kotori nodded, and took one of the cans with both hands.

dialogues.jp:
そしてそのまま、ほうけたような顔で、地面を
じっと見つめている。
dialogues.en: Then, she just stared at the ground.
dialogues.text: Then, she just stared at the ground.

dialogues.jp:
「ことり、ほんとに大丈夫かよ？　何か、今日
　は変だぞ」
dialogues.en: "Kotori, is everything okay? You seem different today."
dialogues.text: "Kotori, is everything okay? You seem different today."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "...Kotori?"

dialogues.jp:
そっと、肩に手を乗せる。ことりは、背中に氷
を入れられたような顔を向けた。その反応に、
こっちが驚いてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I placed my hand on her shoulder, causing her to jump in
surprise from my touch.
dialogues.text:
I placed my hand on her shoulder, causing her to jump in
surprise from my touch.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ご、ごめんなさい……ちょっと、考え事
　をしてて……」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, I, I'm sorry... I'm just thinking... about
something..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, I, I'm sorry... I'm just thinking... about
something..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "A, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "A, ahh..."

dialogues.jp:
少し、ばつの悪い思いを抱きながら、俺はパン
の包装を破いた。
dialogues.en:
Feeling bad myself for disturbing her, I started opening my
bread packet.
dialogues.text:
Feeling bad myself for disturbing her, I started opening my
bread packet.

dialogues.jp:
ことりが缶のプルトップを開けた。一口含むと、
魂まで抜けてしまったようなため息をつく。
dialogues.en:
Kotori opened the can, and took a mouthful of the black tea.
She then sighed, as if her spirit was expelled from that
sigh.
dialogues.text:
Kotori opened the can, and took a mouthful of the black tea.
She then sighed, as if her spirit was expelled from that
sigh.

dialogues.jp:
地面に顔を向けたまま、話しかけてくる気配も
ない。ほんとに、どうしたんだろう？
dialogues.en:
She continued staring at the floor, not uttering a single
word. Really, what's going on?
dialogues.text:
She continued staring at the floor, not uttering a single
word. Really, what's going on?

dialogues.jp:
「ことり、体調が悪いんだったら、早退した方
　がいいんじゃないか？　それか、保健室に行
　くとか」
dialogues.en:
"Kotori, if you're not feeling well, maybe you should leave
early? We can go to the nurse's office now..."
dialogues.text:
"Kotori, if you're not feeling well, maybe you should leave
early? We can go to the nurse's office now..."

dialogues.jp:
肩の下がり具合が、疲れを感じさせる。ことり
は視線はそのままに、ぽそりと呟いた。
dialogues.en:
Her shoulders were drooping, giving me the impression of
tiredness. Kotori glanced at me, then whispered.
dialogues.text:
Her shoulders were drooping, giving me the impression of
tiredness. Kotori glanced at me, then whispered.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……大丈夫です……きっと、大丈夫」
dialogues.en: "...I'm alright... I'd be fine."
dialogues.text: "...I'm alright... I'd be fine."

dialogues.jp: 言い聞かせるような言葉。
dialogues.en: That's what she said.
dialogues.text: That's what she said.

dialogues.jp: けれど、あまりに力のない口調だった。
dialogues.en: Yet her own voice seemed lifeless.
dialogues.text: Yet her own voice seemed lifeless.

dialogues.jp: ◆元気のないことり１◆
dialogues.en: ◆Depressed Kotori 1◆
dialogues.text: ◆Depressed Kotori 1◆

dialogues.jp: いつも、ことりと一緒に昼食を取っている。
dialogues.en:
I was waiting for Kotori for our usual lunch break at the
courtyard.
dialogues.text:
I was waiting for Kotori for our usual lunch break at the
courtyard.

dialogues.jp: 遅れる事のない彼女が、何故か今日は遅かった。
dialogues.en: For some reason, the usually punctual Kotori was late today.
dialogues.text: For some reason, the usually punctual Kotori was late today.

dialogues.jp:
２０分も過ぎた頃ようやく来てくれたのだが、こ
とりは元気がなさそうだった。
dialogues.en:
She eventually arrived after 20 minutes, but she didn't look
good at all.
dialogues.text:
She eventually arrived after 20 minutes, but she didn't look
good at all.
